snippet.title: My Factory 我的工厂 // Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/702080/My_Factory/

末日之后，重建工厂。研发科技，加强武装。收集材料，生产发财。
-
After the apocalypse, rebuild factories, research and develop technology, strengthen armaments, collect materials, produce and make a fortune.

Developed by
Great God

Music has been added since the original video was silent
